notes: Splat Suite 1.20.0 - the seven tabs become five places in a rail down the left: Start, Solve, Result, Runs, Setup. The project bar now runs across the top of every screen, with a chip per stage read from the project's own record - a part-finished align reads 'Align 500/556' in amber and a failed one a red cross, where before a failed align showed a green tick. One RUN button at the bottom, named after the work, with a caret to start from any stage; the line above it says what the run will actually use - photo count, quality, engine, camera grouping, GPS - read live from the controls and counted from the folder the align will read. A pre-flight strip lists what the app already knows is wrong before you press it, including a project whose images folder holds more than one capture. The log is docked, filtered and copyable. Result opens with what happened rather than a form. The three tool paths moved to Setup > Tools. Also includes 1.19.1: a farm node now shows the person sitting at it what it is doing, who for, and what closing would cost. Honest note: this does not reduce the control count - about 150 to 154 - thinning each screen is the next step. First release since 1.15.2; it carries 1.15.3 through 1.20.0, including the LAN render farm (1.19.0), the one-destination project model (1.18.0) and the Start screen (1.17.0).
